python - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('w42/seat_position_strategy_map')
with (base / 'position_strategy_matrix.csv').open(newline='') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
assert len(rows) == 17
assert set(rows[0]) == {'role','phase','public_state_prerequisites','book_concept','current_detector_coverage','missing_detector','suggested_metric','leakage_risk','phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies'}
for name in ['summary.json', 'manifest.json']:
    json.loads((base / name).read_text())
print('validated', len(rows), 'rows')
PY
